command: python bench/run.py --name cpu_step --gpu 4 --model Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B@c1899de289a0 --backends holon nanovllm --max-batch 256 --blocking-sync --traces bench/traces/decode_b256.jsonl
method: In-process engines driven by bench/driver.py, one scheduling step per call; client-side timestamps taken when a step returns a token. TTFT = first token - release (arrival, or previous turn's last token + gap); TPOT = (last - first) / (tokens - 1) per request; throughput = output tokens / (last token - first release). Decode steps = steps at peak batch that return no first token; decode tok/s = their tokens / their wall time. CPU ms/step = time.process_time() delta around step() on those steps, measured with --blocking-sync (CUDA primary context in blocking-sync mode and torch events created blocking, so waiting for the GPU sleeps and is not counted). Greedy, ignore_eos, fixed output lengths; warmup on the same shapes with other prompt tokens, excluded.
